sources.reference: 第一行三格为上版第 1 帧，第二行三格为上版第 2 帧。各自缩到 512 像素，拼成 1536×1024。
sources.actual_prompt: Produce a professional 2D animation INBETWEEN SHEET for an existing Chinese chibi GIF, in the EXACT layout of attached image: full 1536x1024 landscape sheet, 3 columns by 2 rows, SIX SQUARE 512x512 borderless panels, read left-to-right top row then bottom row. Use all six equal tiles each filled by a complete waist-up scene on pure uniform opaque white. Preserve the input's exact framing and fixed character positions individually in each panel. The input is a layout of only two existing extreme drawings: repeats of earlier drawing on top row, repeats of later drawing on bottom row. Replace the repeated drawings with SIX distinct clean sequential poses spanning the gap. Panel 1 is the earlier reference pose, panel 6 is the later reference pose, panels 2,3,4,5 show respectively 20%,40%,60%,80% progress between them. Draw fresh, fully opaque art, clean silhouette and one set of features per frame, no blur, translucent overlapping, double outlines, mesh tugging, duplicate props, captions, writing, panel numbers or grid lines. Keep original art/eye shape/costume/line thickness. The character size, crop and persistent static features should match the endpoints; do not center or shrink figures to expose more body. Even paced motion with clean gesture arcs; this is six frames of ONE small motion, not six alternate expressions. Exact action for THIS sheet: Rise from the low bow; left silver girl raises her OWN right navy sleeve diagonally across her chest toward an open high-five. Flower remains offscreen. Right florist remains attentive, hands low.

Florist has nearly raised her gaze. Neither girl holds a stem or flower. Navy and green bodies and faces at exactly the same screen positions as the references.
